_comment: Slack App Manifest — create your personal YC Radar app in ~3 minutes. In Slack: api.slack.com/apps → 'Create New App' → 'From an app manifest' → paste this JSON → review → install to workspace. Then copy the 'Bot User OAuth Token' into your .env as SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.
